description: Conan 1.0.2 — marker-independent pty↔session correlation (Claude Code 2.1.173 stopped writing ~/.claude/sessions markers, killing the Timeline, both ↻ refresh CTAs, the Compact bar, and passive /usage capture) plus /usage probe hardening and Sonnet-window capture.

userStories.title: Hook reports the live claude pid on every event
userStories.description: As the gateway, I need each hook event to carry the pid of the claude process that fired it, so sessions can be correlated to ptys without Claude Code's marker files.
acceptanceCriteria: scripts/hooks/send-event.mjs determines the nearest ancestor process named 'claude' (walk the ppid chain via ps; do NOT assume a fixed depth) and includes it as claudePid in the event payload
When no claude ancestor is found, claudePid is omitted (payload shape otherwise unchanged — existing consumers unaffected)
Manual check: run the hook script as a child of a live claude session (or a mock ancestor named claude) and confirm the POSTed JSON contains the right claudePid
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: The hook runs under a shell layer spawned by claude — the ppid walk must search upward by process name, not depth. Keep the script dependency-free (plain node, ps -axo pid=,ppid=,comm=).

userStories.title: Gateway persists claude_pid per session
userStories.description: As the gateway, I want to store the hook-reported claude pid on the session row, so correlation can match pty descendants against known live session pids.
acceptanceCriteria: session table gains a nullable claude_pid INTEGER column via idempotent ALTER on boot (existing DBs upgrade cleanly; fresh DBs include it in CREATE)
POST /api/claude/events accepts an optional claudePid field and updates session.claude_pid for that session_id
Events without claudePid leave the existing claude_pid value untouched
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: DB init lives in src/db/. Follow the existing idempotent-init pattern (the 1.0.1 loop's session columns are precedent).

userStories.title: Marker-independent correlation fallback in correlate.ts
userStories.description: As a Conan user, I want my terminal correlated to its Claude session even though Claude Code 2.1.173 no longer writes ~/.claude/sessions/<pid>.json, so the Timeline and live-pty features work again.
acceptanceCriteria: correlateClaudeSession keeps the marker path as primary, then falls back to matching the pty's descendant pids (existing ps walk) against session.claude_pid values of recent sessions from the DB, then the existing cwd+recency heuristic stays as last resort
With ~/.claude/sessions empty and a live hooked claude running in a Conan terminal, GET /api/terminals returns a non-null sessionId for that terminal
GET /api/claude/sessions/:id/widgets returns hasLivePty: true for that session
Two terminals in the same cwd with two live sessions correlate to their own sessions (pid match wins over cwd heuristic)
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using automate-browser skill: Timeline panel shows hook events for the live terminal, and the ↻ /context and ↻ /usage buttons are visible
userStories.notes: Suggested skills: automate-browser. ⚠ Dogfooding footgun: this story edits src/terminal/* — the loop must run OUTSIDE the Conan dock (npm start, never tsx watch from an in-dock session). DB access from correlate.ts should go through a thin injected lookup to keep the function testable.

userStories.title: Regression guard: surface uncorrelated-session health signal
userStories.description: As a Conan developer, I want a visible signal when a running session has no correlated pty, so the next silent Claude Code behavior change is caught in QA instead of by users.
acceptanceCriteria: Gateway tracks when a session with status 'running' and a live Conan terminal has had no pty correlation for more than 60 seconds
The condition is exposed as a field on an existing API payload (e.g. correlationDegraded on GET /api/terminals or /api/health) and logged once per occurrence (no log spam)
Field is false/absent in the healthy case
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Keep it cheap — piggyback on the existing reaper/poll cadence rather than a new timer.

userStories.title: Harden the throwaway /usage probe
userStories.description: As a Conan user, I want the account-global usage windows to refresh reliably, because on Claude Code 2.1.173 the probe intermittently returns nothing and the HUD goes stale.
acceptanceCriteria: On a parse miss the probe logs the raw (ANSI-stripped, truncated) scrape so the failure mode is diagnosable from logs
Probe retries exactly once on an empty parse (hard cap — each probe spawns a real claude)
A failed probe surfaces probeError (string) in the GET /api/claude/usage payload instead of silently returning planUtilization: null, and still never clobbers the last good cache
GET /api/claude/usage?probe=1 returns populated planUtilization on a healthy run (live verification)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Observed 2026-06-11: probe succeeded at ~10:10 and failed at ~10:24 on the same machine/version — suspect the capture window vs the TUI render timing. src/usage/probe.ts.

userStories.title: Capture the Sonnet-only week window (incl. 0%)
userStories.description: As a Conan user, I want the third /usage window (Current week, Sonnet only) to appear in the HUD like it does in the terminal, instead of permanently 'Awaiting capture'.
acceptanceCriteria: The probe/live scrape captures the full three-window /usage frame (the Sonnet window renders last — ensure the capture bound doesn't cut it off)
Add a parser fixture test from a real Claude Code 2.1.173 /usage frame that includes 'Current week (Sonnet only) 0% used', asserting sevenDaySonnet = {utilizationPct: 0}
Tests pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: matchWindow (src/usage/probe.ts:415) already parses '0%used' — the bug is upstream in what the scrape feeds it. Capture the fixture from a real frame, not a hand-typed one.

userStories.title: End-to-end QA: all correlation-dependent surfaces restored
userStories.description: As a Conan user, I want everything the marker break killed verified working again in the running app, so 1.0.2 can ship with confidence.
acceptanceCriteria: With ~/.claude/sessions empty and a live hooked claude session: Timeline renders hook rows live (no 'no Claude session yet'), ↻ /context and ↻ /usage buttons visible and functional, and running /usage in the terminal updates the HUD windows with a fresh 'captured 0m ago' hint (passive capture works)
Build chip 30-min window (1.0.1 US-004) is now eye-testable and behaves per its original criteria
Compact/handoff action bar arms when context pressure is simulated or hasLivePty is true under pressure
cd ui && npm run build passes clean
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using automate-browser skill: screenshot the Timeline with live rows and the Usage tab with all three windows populated
userStories.notes: Suggested skills: automate-browser. Integration story — no new code expected; fix regressions found here in place. Remember the stale-sidecar gotcha: gateway/terminal changes need npm run build:sidecar before any tauri:build verification.
